newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia to buy S.Africa attack helicopters-report.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia to buy S.Africa attack helicopters-report.

text.p: Malaysia has agreed to buy Rooivalk combat helicopters from South Africa as part of efforts to strengthen its air force, the national Bernama news agency said on Friday.
It quoted Defence Minister Syed Hamid Albar as saying the Royal Malaysian Air Force would need eight such aircraft under its modenisation plan.
But he said the number of aircraft to be purchased would be determined only after negotiations between the Malaysian government and the helicopter's manufacturer, Denel Group.
"We'll probably purchase eight aircraft but it all depends on the negotiation of the whole deal, and this includes transfer of technology if possible," he told reporters.
Malaysia also needed to look at its financial strength before it could say how many helicopters it was going to buy, Syed Hamid said.

The South African firm has been courting the Malaysian government for more than two years to sell its product. The company renewed its campaign early this month with the visit of President Nelson Mandela to Kuala Lumpur.
Syed Hamid has said that if the purchase went through, the deal would include a local components manufacturing facility for the Rooivalk.
Defence ministry officials were not immediately available for comment.
